🏃About

A simple workflow for object removal tasks. Uses red bounding boxes (bbox for short). Runs on the Flux 2 Klein 9B Q4_K_S GGUF model and object removal lora.

💻My specs

  • 🔥GPU - RTX 5070 12GB

  • 📦RAM - 48 GB RAM DDR5 6000

  • 🧠CPU - Ryzen 7500F

🌐Model links

Main modelFLUX.2-klein-9B-GGUF: https://huggingface.co/unsloth/FLUX.2-klein-9B-GGUF

Object removal lora: https://huggingface.co/prithivMLmods/FLUX.2-Klein-Object-Remover-Bbox

📖How to use

1) Make red rectangles on your image

2) Load clip, vae, gguf model, lora

3) Run
